The JSON statement transfers_out is the Total column's net 2,762; detail records the funds gross (General Fund -2,835, Debt Service Fund +73). 2,835 - 2,762 = 73 = the Debt Service Fund transfer in netted by the Total column. Nothing missing or duplicated.
